evidence_scope: Focused validation for the first edit of imported aliases with shared source key writers. This qualifies the tested key-edit path only and does not claim completion of the broader native timeline or axis goal.

validation.totals_method: Summed result entries that report C++ cases and assertions. Studio values are the corresponding suite row; Python and CLI are separate reported case totals.
validation.test_result: All 20 final checks exited successfully. All 13 test binaries with before/after hashes were unchanged during their test runs.
validation.profiling: The transaction envelope has ENGINE_PROFILE instrumentation. No timing was collected and no performance result is claimed.

tested_behavior: The native importer fixture uses the source parser's eight-field key row shape for pc.invert.mix. It is a parser-verified fixture, not licensed-reference parity evidence.
The first edit of an imported alias captures shared writer declarations before key authoring and maps projected pins while clearing only the newly captured alias identity.
The transaction clears group overlays before restoring declarations, and tests cover shared move, delete, easing, metadata, track changes, new-key authoring, and no-op or stale-pin refusal.
History and host state remain unchanged on refusal. Tests exercise callback refusal, history refusal, admission refusal, and a bounded transaction budget before callback execution.

Captured key API limits are threaded through draft pre-admission. This documents only captured authoring limits. Legacy uncaptured API paths retain their existing behavior, and ImageGraphHistory has a separate capacity.

iteration_history.cause: A HasNativeExecutor call used the wrong argument form, and the fixture treated OwnedPayload as if it had has_value().
The standalone key-pin helper needed the FrameTime.hpp declaration.

Six failures came from malformed importer rows. One assertion treated a keyed Boolean false payload as no trigger, but trigger presence follows keyed state; the fixture was changed to a Float control for value semantics.

iteration_history.result: Studio suite had 6 failures in each batch
iteration_history.cause: The importer fixture still used malformed key rows.
The authoring fixture had no initialized static value.

iteration_history.repair: The fixture now uses the validated eight-field rows and has an initialized authored value where required.

source_snapshots.comparison_note: The final build-7 snapshots match across all 55 watched paths. In the initial before/after comparison, the 42 paths outside the staged feature set retained their hashes.

hash_note: These are full tested-file hashes from the after snapshot, including the entire ImageComposer.cpp file. The ImageComposer.cpp diff in the staged feature set was selective because that file also contains peer edits.
remaining_gaps: The broader native timeline and axis goal remains active.
